summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing it will report second quarter 2026 financial results and host a semiannual conference call on August 11, 2026. This is a routine earnings release notification with no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special-situation event. The filing provides dial-in details and instructions for accessing the webcast and replay, along with forward-looking statements and contact information. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a standard earnings press release in the US. No deal terms, advisor names, or structural changes are mentioned.
